title: One Announcement, many Deliveries; guidelines and lifecycle the same in pod and cloud
description:
**Design:** ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md (2026-11-16, Ryan). One Announcement (the decision, no channel) with one Delivery per channel (words, image, account, attempts, result address). Retries are attempts; corrections are new Deliveries that supersede the old one. Three cloud models (X announcement rows, newsletter ISSUE#/ROUNDUP# rows, ALERT# de-dup rows) plus the notifications story.published event become Announcement plus Delivery; the per-reader send ledger and transport stay in Caducus. Guidelines become GUIDELINE.md folders (cloud schema version 2). Lifecycle keys (stage, rating, review stamps) share names in a pod and in the cloud.

**Decisions accepted by Ryan, 2026-11-16:** (1) Announcement and Delivery are two records. (2) Guidelines become files with cloud schema version 2, converted once per site, no dual reader. (3) Pod review stamps are unverified claims; no stronger pod (no signature checks, no pod checklist, no local review ledger). Also standing: X feed stays OFF until the reshape lands and Ryan turns it on; no live X rows exist so nothing migrates there; a pod with no site is private and a load never publishes; a pod never grants five stars; a pod delivers in manual mode only.

**Related, not duplicated:** PPY-09ee86 (X announcements; this epic reshapes its model before go-live), PPY-824c14 (Caducus move; slices 6 and 7 follow it), PPY-2a2a8a (guidelines as data; slices 9 and 10 change what it built). The local-pod epic (profile, pod check, pod load) is not on this board yet (only the newsroom-pods initiative 2844a5 is); slices 11-13 depend on it when filed.

**Done when:** every slice is closed, the three old models are gone, and the p.apyr.us page is published. No real email addresses in any spec or fixture.
